title: US EcoTaxa demo, project 2 (Zooscan test set)
abstract: Demonstration export of EcoTaxa project 2 (US EcoTaxa demo) on the Ocean Metrics demo node, resolved to WoRMS and aggregated per sample and taxon. Eight test objects from the upstream EcoTaxa test set; classifier predictions only.
verification: classifier predictions only; no validated object in this demo project
note: the upstream test set; nothing here is a real survey; the license is the demo's, the project's own applies in production

title: SFER MBON PlanktoScope (migrated from EcoTaxa 11310)
abstract: Plankton imaged with a PlanktoScope on South Florida MBON (SFER) cruises, classified in EcoTaxa project 11310 on the Ifremer node and migrated to the Ocean Metrics demo node as project 4, resolved to WoRMS and aggregated per sample and taxon. Occurrences come from validated objects only.
organization: NOAA Atlantic Oceanographic and Meteorological Laboratory (AOML)
associated_parties: Di Geronimo, Sebastian | University of South Florida | annotator; Lilly Verrill | University of South Florida | annotator; Ana Carolina Peralta | University of South Florida | annotator
verification: occurrences from validated objects only; every object, predicted ones included, is in the TSV export
note: creator, contact and annotators from Enrique Montes, 2026-11-11; CC BY 4.0 rather than his CC BY-NC 4.0, which NCEI does not accept (Matt Biddle, 2026-11-11), pending his confirmation; the abstract is still a draft for him to review; volumes withheld until the owner confirms the volume fields (2026-11-12: dilution factors of 0.5 and -0.5 on the 200 um samples, total volumes from 0 to 2.3e7)
